dropped.item: The explicit claim "It isn't cheaper" (post-editing isn't actually a cheaper version of the work) no longer appears as a standalone statement. The idea survives later in "I've saved no effort."

changed.item: Original: the offer is made "as if that were a discount on the real work," an implied framing. Edit: "They present it as a discount on the real work," which explicitly attributes the framing to the agency.
